title: Owner: check fpv_preflight against the real fleet after the import
goal: The owner confirms the verdicts match the real batteries and drones
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "y" to the pre-flight check plan (earlier: "pre flight check, ok" and "real" data).

After F-017-T03 has imported the owner's real data and nerv:F-101-T08 points NERV at FPVBuddy, the owner follows a copy-paste page (docs/acceptance/f024-preflight-<date>.md, written by the agent): (1) call fpv_preflight from the MCP client or ask NERV "cosa devo preparare per sabato?"; (2) compare the batteries listed as ready, needing storage charge or check due with the real packs on the bench; (3) compare the flagged drones and low spares with the real ones; (4) note any wrong verdict
The owner decides whether the thresholds are right; a wrong verdict becomes a B- record, not an edit to this step
privacy: The owner's real data stays on their machine; the acceptance page holds invented examples only.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: read and compare a few lines of output. Not a measurement.
